name: cite
title: Zolai–English dictionary source
description: Configuration of the cite data, format 3: the tables that hold the lexicon, the ids that link them, the markup in which entries are typed and shown, and every closed list. The file is the single source for both tooling and readers; Format.md explains the same rules in prose. Every list below is closed: a value that is not listed is an error.

keyword.name: Zolai (Tedim)
keyword.description: Language of every keyword, of the attributes s, a, b and v, and of the Zolai part of an example.

eng.name: English
eng.description: Terms and definitions in English; translations of the examples.

mya.name: Burmese
mya.description: Terms and definitions in Burmese; translations of the examples.

nob.name: Norwegian
nob.description: Terms and definitions in Norwegian Bokmål; translations of the examples.

format.description: Physical rules of a table file. The first line names the columns. A value never holds a tab or a line break; an absent value is empty. Rows are sorted by their columns, an id by its number.

id.description: An id is a letter and a number. A number is given once and never reused. A sharded table keeps a row in the file named by the block of its first column: the number divided by the block size.

word.description: Every written form. A word without a sense is a form that only points at other words through a relation.

columns.spelling: The word as written. Case is significant. Unique.
columns.status: Code of the word status list.

columns.number: Number of the sense within its word, shown as khut.1. Never reused. May be empty for a sense of type todo.
columns.status: Code of the sense status list.
columns.origin: Language or word the keyword was borrowed from.
columns.source: Where the sense is attested: Bible verses and codes of the source list with a locator.
columns.note: Remark that belongs to the status: what is uncertain, what a reviewer needs to know.

gloss.description: Terms and definition of a sense in one language. One folder per language code.

columns.terms: Words of that language with the meaning of the sense, the best first.
columns.definition: Explanation of the meaning. May hold links and mentions.
columns.text: Remark on usage or grammar that is not the meaning itself. May hold links and mentions.

relation.description: Links between senses and words. The kinds are in the relation list.

columns.from: Sense id; for the kind see, a word id.
columns.to: Word id, or a sense id when one meaning of the target is meant.
columns.order: Position of the target among the targets of the same kind, from 1.

example.description: Every example sentence or fragment, stored once.

columns.source: Where the text comes from: a Bible verse or a code of the source list with a locator. May be empty.
columns.text: The text in Zolai, in full.

usage.description: Which sense an example shows, and where in the text the keyword stands.

columns.start: Positions of the word of the text at which the keyword starts, counted from 1. A position is repeated when the keyword stands more than once in that word.
columns.length: Number of words the keyword covers.

translation.description: Translation of an example in one language. One folder per language code.

link.description: Words of a language that are not a term of any sense, each sent to the closest senses. One file per language code. A link does not state that the meanings are equal.

columns.status: Code of the sense status list.
columns.note: Remark that belongs to the status.

note.description: Open points for an editor: concepts without a keyword, words whose meaning is not settled.

sequence.description: The highest id number given out, per kind of id.

status.description: State of review. The table holds the code; the markup holds the name in q.

0.name: retired
0.description: No longer part of the lexicon. The row stays so that its id is not reused.

1.name: low
1.description: Drafted on thin evidence; likely to need correction.

2.name: draft
2.description: Drafted and not yet reviewed. The status of a typed row without q.

3.name: reviewed
3.description: Read by a reviewer who found no fault; not yet confirmed by the maintainer.

4.name: confirmed
4.description: Confirmed by a speaker of the language.

5.name: disputed
5.description: Reviewers disagree, or a fault was reported and is not yet resolved.

0.name: retired
0.description: No longer part of the lexicon.

2.name: variant
2.description: Another accepted spelling of a standard word.

3.name: nonstandard
3.description: A spelling met in texts that the lexicon does not recommend.

s.name: synonym
s.description: The target has the same meaning.

a.name: antonym
a.description: The target has the opposite meaning.

b.name: base
b.description: The keyword is a plural, suffixed or prefixed form of the target.

j.name: join
j.description: The keyword joins or respells the targets. Several targets: separate words written as one, in their order. One target: the same word in another spelling.

v.name: variant
v.description: The target is another spelling of the keyword and has no sense of its own.

see.name: redirect
see.description: From a word to a word: the form occurs only as part of the target.

core.name: Core lexicon
core.description: General vocabulary of everyday life and of modern subjects, independent of the Bible text.

bible.name: Bible lexicon
bible.description: Vocabulary drawn from the Bible text.

name.name: Names
name.description: Names of persons, peoples, places, clans, months, days and books.

concept.name: Concept without keyword
concept.description: A concept of the core lexicon that still lacks a Zolai keyword.

english.name: English word without sense
english.description: A common English word for which no sense is close enough.

article.name: Undetermined word of the articles
article.description: A word frequent in the news articles whose meaning could not be determined.

book.name: Undetermined word of the grammar book
book.description: A word of Paunam Khenna leh Kampau Luanzia whose meaning could not be determined.

editor.name: Note for the editor
editor.description: A remark on a keyword of the Bible lexicon.

keyword.description: The Zolai headword that starts a row. Case is significant: Pasian and pasian are different keywords. Words are joined by one space, one hyphen or one apostrophe; a final apostrophe is allowed.

markup.description: The markup in which entries are typed and shown. A row is a keyword, the separator and attributes written (key:value); an example row is a sense key, the separator, the Zolai text with the keyword written as ~, the translation separator and the English translation. The commands import and pull turn markup into table changes and tables into markup.

i.name: sense
i.description: Which sense the row is. Absent: a new sense. A number or a sense id: that sense is replaced by the row. A plus sign: a new sense although a similar one exists.

t.name: type
t.description: Word class of the keyword. Exactly one code from the type list.

c.name: category
c.description: What kind of thing the keyword names. One or more codes from the category list.

f.name: field
f.description: Subject area in which this sense is used. One or more codes from the field list.

w.name: term
w.description: English word or words with the same meaning as this sense of the keyword. Items of one row are interchangeable; a different meaning goes on its own row.

d.name: definition
d.description: English explanation of the meaning, used when no English term fits or in addition to one. May contain cross-references.

s.name: synonym
s.description: Keywords with the same meaning. An item is a keyword, or a sense key such as khut.1 when one meaning is meant.

a.name: antonym
a.description: Keywords with the opposite meaning. An item is a keyword or a sense key.

b.name: base
b.description: The keyword this form is built from, for plural, suffixed and prefixed forms. One keyword that exists in the data.

j.name: joins
j.description: The keywords that this written form joins or respells. Several items: separate words written as one, as aom joins a and om. One item: the same word in another spelling; such a row may leave out w and d and then carries the meaning of the keyword it names. Every item is a keyword that exists in the data.

v.name: variant
v.description: Other spellings of the same keyword. An item has no sense of its own; a word row with the status variant is made for it.

o.name: origin
o.description: Language the keyword comes from, optionally followed by a comma and the source word.

r.name: reference
r.description: Where this sense is attested. A Bible verse is written book.chapter.verse with book numbers 1 to 66, and a verse range uses a hyphen. Any other source is written as a code from the source list, optionally followed by a colon and a locator inside that source.

q.name: status
q.description: Name of the sense status, optionally followed by a comma and a remark. Absent: draft.

e.name: example
e.description: On an example row: the id of the example that the row replaces, or a plus sign for a new example although one with the same text and source exists.

name.name: proper name
name.description: Name of one person, people, place, clan, book or other individual thing. The keyword starts with an uppercase letter.

prep.name: preposition
prep.description: Relation word translated by an English preposition.

part.name: particle
part.description: Particle: a prefix, suffix or sentence-final word with a grammatical function.

ppm.name: postpositional marker
ppm.description: Marker placed after a word to show case, place, time or tense.

num.name: number
num.description: Cardinal or ordinal number, in words or digits.

phrase.name: phrase
phrase.description: Fixed combination of words listed as one keyword.

see.name: redirect
see.description: A form that only points to another keyword. Typed as the type followed by exactly one link; stored as a relation of the kind see, not as a sense.

todo.name: to do
todo.description: Keyword collected but not yet described. The note of the status says why.

people.name: people
people.description: Name of a nation, tribe or group of people.

land.name: land
land.description: Name of a country, region or territory.

place.name: place
place.description: Name of a place that fits no narrower category.

khua.name: village or town
khua.description: Name of a village or town.

star.name: star
star.description: Name of a star or constellation.

kha.name: month
kha.description: Month of the year. Rows are of type n.

ni.name: day of the week
ni.description: Day of the week. Rows are of type n.

book.name: Bible book
book.description: Name of a book of the Bible.

testament.name: testament
testament.description: Name of a testament of the Bible.

animal.name: animal
animal.description: Animal, bird, fish or other living creature.

everyday.name: everyday
everyday.description: Common words of daily speech: greetings, basic actions, qualities and things.

social.name: social
social.description: Community, relationships, customs, manners and public life.

body.name: body
body.description: The human body and its parts.

home.name: home
home.description: House, furniture, clothing and household things.

it.name: information technology
it.description: Computers, phones, software and the internet.

politics.name: politics
politics.description: Government, law, elections, war and public affairs.

religion.name: religion
religion.description: Church life, belief and worship outside the Bible text.

zai.description: English to Zolai dictionary data of the zolai-ai project, merged there from the dictionaries of Thang Khan Dal, Dal Lian Haokip, Mang Cin Pau Gualnam and the ZomiDictionary application, and the English to Zolai word list of the same project. The locator is the English headword.

moby.name: Moby Thesaurus
moby.description: Moby Thesaurus by Grady Ward, public domain. Relates an English word to English words of similar meaning. The locator is the English term of a sense through which the linked word was found.

zd.name: Zomi Daily
zd.description: Articles of the news site Zomi Daily, written in Zolai, 2008 to 2026. The locator is the article id of the site.

ts.name: Tongsan

ts.permission: Requested by the editor in October 2026; the wording of the credit is not yet received. Only single words and short fragments of sentences are quoted.

zp.name: Zomipedia

pk.credit: Words, word pairs, sayings and examples from Paunam Khenna leh Kampau Luanzia by Sia Cin Sian Pau
pk.permission: Not yet asked. Only single words, word pairs, sayings and short fragments of sentences are quoted; the text of the book is not stored.

bible.description: Bible translations read by the tooling. Paths are relative to the repository root. The tooling never writes to these files.

rule.name: file order
rule.description: The rows of a table file are sorted by their columns and no row occurs twice.

rule.name: id
rule.description: An id is the letter of its kind and a number; an id, and a key that is one per row, occurs once.

rule.name: sequence
rule.description: The sequence table holds one row per kind of id, and no id is above the last number given.

rule.name: reference
rule.description: An id written in a column names an existing row of the table it points at.

rule.name: code
rule.description: A code is listed in the configuration: status, type, category, field, set, relation kind, note kind. A code is named once.

rule.name: spelling
rule.description: A word is written as the keyword pattern allows, and a spelling occurs once.

rule.name: sense number
rule.description: A sense of a type that carries a meaning has a positive whole number that no other sense of the word has.

rule.name: meaning
rule.description: A sense of a type that carries a meaning has a term or a definition, or joins exactly one target.

rule.name: text
rule.description: A value holds nothing that the markup cannot hold: parentheses, the placeholder, the translation separator, double spaces; terms hold no empty or repeated term and no link or mention.

rule.name: link mark
rule.description: A link in prose is written <keyword> or <keyword.number> and names an existing word or sense; prose of an active sense names nothing retired.

rule.name: mention
rule.description: A mention in prose is written {text}; braces are balanced and not empty, hold no link, and do not name a standard word of the lexicon other than the keyword.

rule.name: relation
rule.description: A redirect leads from a word to one other word; every other kind leads from a sense. The targets of one kind are ordered from 1. A variant is a word with the status variant and no sense. A join does not name its own keyword. An active sense or word does not lead to a retired one, and a retired word is not redirected.

rule.name: source
rule.description: A source is a Bible verse written book.chapter.verse or the code of a listed source with an optional locator.

rule.name: example
rule.description: An example has a text that the markup can hold, is used by at least one sense, and does not repeat the text, source and translation of another example.

rule.name: usage
rule.description: A usage gives the positions and the length in words at which the keyword of the sense stands in the example.

rule.name: translation
rule.description: An example has a translation in at least one language; a translation is a text that the markup can hold.

rule.name: link
rule.description: A linked word is lowercase, is not a term of a sense in that language, and names each of its senses once.

rule.name: name
rule.description: A keyword with a sense of the type name begins with a capital letter or a digit.

rule.name: duplicate sense
rule.description: Two senses of one word do not share type, category, terms and definition.

rule.name: note
rule.description: A note has a subject.

rule.name: credits
rule.description: CREDITS.md is generated from the source list and the Bible texts and is up to date.
